meta.title: Evangelische Termine – test site
meta.author: habakuk007
meta.description: WordPress with the plugin mounted, debug output on, one page per shortcode and the widget in a classic sidebar. Start with: npx @wp-playground/cli@latest server --auto-mount --login --blueprint=tests/e2e/blueprint.json

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// One page per shortcode. Region 407 with vid=all gives a list with several pages; 1474 is the maintainer's test organiser.
$pages = array(
	'et-veranstalter'      => '[et_veranstalter vid="all" region="407" itemsperpage="5"]',
	'et-veranstalter-1474' => '[et_veranstalter]',
	'et-teaser'            => '[et_teaser vid="all" region="407" itemsperpage="5"]',
	'et-panels'            => '[et_panels vid="all" region="407" itemsperpage="6"]',
	'et-minical'           => '[et_minical vid="all" region="407"]',
);
foreach ( $pages as $slug => $content ) {
	wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_type'    => 'page',
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_name'    => $slug,
			'post_title'   => $slug,
			'post_content' => '<!-- wp:shortcode -->' . $content . '<!-- /wp:shortcode -->',
		)
	);
}

// The widget in the footer sidebar of Twenty Twenty-One.
update_option(
	'widget_etwidget',
	array(
		2              => array(
			'title'        => 'Nächste Veranstaltungen',
			'vid'          => 'all',
			'region'       => '407',
			'itemsPerPage' => '3',
			'tpl'          => '2',
		),
		'_multiwidget' => 1,
	)
);
$sidebars              = get_option( 'sidebars_widgets', array() );
$sidebars['sidebar-1'] = array( 'etwidget-2' );
update_option( 'sidebars_widgets', $sidebars );
